rationale.consistency: Mirrors v6 client patterns (409 fallback, closeResponse, httperr classification) and expv2 injection style; hand-rolled HTTP client instead of SDK is a deviation but justified in comments.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles 409, missing upload URL, ctx cancellation, aborted/completed before start, unparseable durations; unknown abort reasons map to code 0 and secrets config is set even when endpoint empty.
rationale.scope: Core flow matches requirement; buildConfigFromRuntimeConfig tuning mapping and the clientcfg package (whose doc claims sharing that isn't wired) slightly exceed the ask; PollInterval hardcoded to the default.
rationale.readability: Clear names and focused files; comments explain non-obvious choices (no auth on presigned PUT, provisioningMode set once).
rationale.robustness: provisioningNotifier can be nil after a failed NewClient, leading to a nil-interface panic in testFinished; randomHex ignores rand errors; retry logic is otherwise careful with body replay and ctx.
rationale.maintainability: Well-separated packages and injectable interfaces; some duplication (apiClient kept only for host config, full provisioning client built in output just to notify, per-call HTTPClient in notify).
